name: New lead assigned
description: Notifies a team member that a new lead has been assigned to them.
subject: New lead assigned: {{organisation}}
preheader: {{full_name}}, interested in {{service}}. Please review and make first contact.

blocks.text:
Hi {{assignee_name}},

A new lead has been assigned to you. Please review the record and make first contact.

name: Proposal viewed or accepted
description: Notifies the account owner when a client views or accepts a proposal.
subject: Proposal activity: {{organisation}}
preheader: The client has viewed or accepted the proposal. Check the record and follow up.

blocks.text:
Hi {{assignee_name}},

{{full_name}} at {{organisation}} has viewed or accepted the proposal for {{project_name}}. The record shows which, and when.

- If viewed: follow up while it is fresh.
- If accepted: start the contract and onboarding steps.

name: Payment received
description: Notifies the finance or account owner that a client payment has been recorded.
subject: Payment received: {{invoice_number}}
preheader: {{amount}} from {{organisation}}. Reconcile and update the record.

blocks.text:
Hi {{assignee_name}},

A payment has been recorded against invoice {{invoice_number}}. Please reconcile it, mark the invoice paid and confirm the client receipt has gone out.

name: Task or follow-up due
description: Reminds a team member that an assigned task or follow-up is due.
subject: Task due: {{task_name}}
preheader: Due {{task_due}}. Complete it or update the due date in the record.

blocks.text:
Hi {{assignee_name}},

The task below is due. Please complete it, or update the due date so the pipeline stays accurate.
